metrics_finding.finding: search-service experienced a significant increase in CPU utilization and mean latency during the failure window, while memory utilization remained relatively stable.

evidence_summary.summary: Search service experienced a significant increase in CPU utilization and mean latency during the failure window, while memory utilization remained relatively stable.

report.suggested_fix: Investigate and optimize search service resources to prevent similar issues.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to the search service. Further investigation is required to confirm this hypothesis.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के पीछे संदेह है कि सर्च सेवा से संबंधित है। आगे शोध करने की आवश्यकता है ताकि यह सिद्ध किया जा सके।
